minstrel.title: A Minstrel at the Hearth
minstrel.text: A traveling minstrel offers to write a song about the guild, for a price.

choices.label: Pay 40 gold for the song
choices.result: The song is catchy. By week's end, children in the street are singing it.

choices.label: Send them on their way
choices.result: The minstrel shrugs and plays for the fishmongers instead.

brawl.title: Tavern Brawl
brawl.text: Two of your members came to blows over a card game. The common room is a mess.

choices.label: Dock both their wages (+30 gold)
choices.result: They grumble, but the chairs get fixed.

choices.label: Let them settle it in the training ring
choices.result: Bruised, sweaty, and friends again. Both learned something.

tax.title: The Tax Collector
tax.text: Carrow's tax collector reminds you that guilds pay a levy. He is very polite about it.

choices.label: Pay the levy (60 gold)
choices.result: The town council notes the guild is in good standing.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.result: Doors in Carrow close a little faster when you pass.

stranger_name.title: A Stranger's Name
stranger_name.text: An old woman begs you to write her husband's name in the ledger. She has already forgotten his face.

choices.label: Write it in the ledger
choices.result: She cries, and thanks you, and leaves lighter than she came.

choices.label: The ledger is for the guild
choices.result: She nods and walks away. By morning she will not remember asking.

scavenger.title: Scrap Seller
scavenger.text: A scavenger offers a crate of salvaged metal.

choices.label: Buy it (50 gold for 5 materials)
choices.result: Good metal, only a little rusted.

choices.label: No thanks
choices.result: He sells it to the smith down the road.

sick.title: Fever in the Bunks
sick.text: A fever is spreading through the barracks.

choices.label: Buy medicine (50 gold)
choices.result: The fever breaks by midweek.

choices.label: Let it run its course
choices.result: One member is laid up for a week.

veteran_tale.title: A Veteran's Tale
veteran_tale.text: An old soldier drinks at your bar and tells stories of the great guilds that marched into the Hush.

choices.label: Buy their drinks all night (20 gold)
choices.result: Your members listen closely. Some of those tricks might keep them alive.

choices.label: Close up early
choices.result: The old soldier wanders off into the night.

lost_child.title: Lost Child
lost_child.text: A child walks into the tavern and cannot say where they live. The street they describe no longer exists.

choices.label: Take them in; ask around (-20 gold)
choices.result: A baker's family takes the child in. You write the child's name in the ledger, just in case.

choices.label: Send them to the temple
choices.result: The priests promise to care for them.

rival_guild.title: Rival Bid
rival_guild.text: A mercenary band is undercutting your contracts in Carrow.

choices.label: Undercut them back (-10% gold next week)
choices.result: The clients come back to you.

choices.label: Ignore them
choices.result: You lose a little face in the market.

shrine_offering.title: The Bell-Wardens' Alms
shrine_offering.text: The Bell-wardens ask for alms to keep candles lit around the cracked Bell.

choices.label: Donate 50 gold
choices.result: The Bell does not ring. But the square feels a little less quiet.

choices.label: Decline
choices.result: The wardens bow and move on.

named_wren.title: A Hand in the Strongbox
named_wren.text: You catch a girl with her arm elbow-deep in the guild's strongbox. She was very nearly good enough not to be caught. She offers to work off the debt.

choices.label: Take her on
choices.result: Wren Tallowmere joins the guild. The strongbox gets a second lock anyway.

choices.label: Hand her to the watch
choices.result: The watch thanks you. Carrow's merchants hear about it.

named_hesk.title: A Captain Without a Ship
named_hesk.text: An old Tidefolk captain drinks alone at your bar. The jellyfish at his shoulder glows for a ship the Hush took, with all his crew. He asks if a guild needs a man who has nothing left to lose.

choices.label: Give him a place (60 gold for his debts)
choices.result: Old Hesk pays his bar tab with your gold and swears on the ledger.

choices.label: Buy him one more drink
choices.result: He tells you his crew's names, one by one, and you write them down.

named_ilyra.title: The Runaway Archivist
named_ilyra.text: A young Mothkin knocks after midnight, wings wet, a lantern of stolen memories under her cloak. The Conclave wants it back. She wants to use it.

choices.label: Shelter her (40 gold to the Conclave's searchers)
choices.result: The searchers take the gold and forget your door. Ilyra Wickwright unpacks her books.

choices.label: Send her home
choices.result: The Conclave sends a polite note of thanks.

named_bramble.title: The Seed at the Door
named_bramble.text: Someone planted a seed by the tavern door last autumn. This morning a Barkborn stood up out of the flowerbed, wearing a carved mask and carrying one of your old axes.

choices.label: Welcome them to the guild
choices.result: Bramblemask nods once and takes a seat by the fire, as if it always had one.

choices.label: Show them the road to the Ember Wood
choices.result: They leave you an armful of hardwood as thanks.

named_sef.title: A Debt in Glass
named_sef.text: A Khepri caravan guard, dismissed for losing a cargo of glass to raiders, offers the guild her bow. She says the raiders are still out there, and she remembers every one of their faces.

choices.label: Hire her (50 gold)
choices.result: Sef Amberglass strings her bow on your table.

choices.label: Wish her luck
choices.result: She shoulders her pack and walks toward the dunes.

tide_fleet.title: The Tide Fleet
tide_fleet.text: The Saltborn Compact is strong. Its fleet opens the sea routes: coastal missions pay 25% more.

trade_cut.title: Trade Routes Cut
trade_cut.text: The Glass Caravans are failing. Without their ships, all prices in Carrow rise 20%.

healing_sap.title: Healing Sap
healing_sap.text: The Rootwardens are thriving and share their healing sap: injuries recover 1 week faster.

conclave_falls.title: The Lanterns Go Out
conclave_falls.text: The Lantern Conclave has collapsed. Without its archivists, the Memorial no longer protects names from the Hush.

open_war.title: Open War
open_war.text: {a} and {b} are both at the height of their power, and both claim the same ground. They are at war. The guild must pick a side; the other will become Hostile.

collapse.title: {faction} Collapses
collapse.text: {faction} has lost everything. The Hush swallows {region}. The Hush rises by 15. A handful of refugees come to the tavern looking for work.

ambush.title: Ambush!
ambush.text: {faction} is hostile to the guild. Its agents have joined the enemy on this mission.

wren.name: Wren Tallowmere
wren.bio: A street thief from Carrow's lower market who tried to rob the guild and was hired instead.

hesk.name: Old Hesk
hesk.bio: A Saltborn captain who lost his ship and crew to the Hush. His jellyfish still remembers all their names.

ilyra.name: Ilyra Wickwright
ilyra.bio: A Lantern Conclave archivist who ran away with a lantern of forbidden memories.

bramble.name: Bramblemask
bramble.bio: Grew from a seed someone planted by the tavern door. Carries fragments of a guild warrior nobody remembers.

sef.name: Sef Amberglass
sef.bio: A Glass Caravans guard hunting the raiders who cost her a cargo and her post.

hush_stages.fading: The Hush is Fading. Fewer missions reach the board, and Hush creatures join ordinary fights.
hush_stages.forgetting: The Hush is Forgetting. Recruits may be Hollow. Prices rise. Regions darken week by week.
hush_stages.unremembered: The Hush is Unremembered. Members at home may forget the guild entirely. The weakest faction crumbles.
